en.text:
Hold [Reload] to cycle this weapon's element between <arc/>Arc, <solar/>Solar, and <void/>Void. Selected element persists through stow and death.

Grants <pve 30% /> <pvp [10%] /> increased damage for 10 seconds upon receiving or applying an elemental buff or debuff that matches the currently selected element. 

Buff can be activated while stowed.
